title: LB Omnichord normal-percussion continuation whitelist during drum fills

contract.normal_event_rule: During a fill, a normal drum-activity event is allowed to fire if and only if its logical role is present in that fill's continue_roles array.
contract.fill_event_rule: Fill events are independent and always use drum_fills_timing.json; continue_roles controls only events from the normal drum-activity pattern.
contract.inactive_role_rule: A whitelisted role that is not present at the currently selected activity level does nothing and requires no special handling.
contract.kit_independence_rule: Whitelist comparison MUST happen on logical timing roles before resolving roles through tiny/Gamma9001/General-MIDI instrument mappings.
contract.no_implicit_defaults: There is no implicit keep-going instrument. Every one of the 270 fills has an explicit complete whitelist.

musical_policy.bass_drum: The normal bass-drum family (low_primary + low_secondary) continues unless the fill itself contains low_primary, in which case the fill owns the coordinated foot part.
musical_policy.pedal_hihat: Pedal hi-hat continues only in the jazz swing/jazz waltz/jazz shuffle families, where left-foot timekeeping through fills is strongly idiomatic.
musical_policy.ordinary_cymbals: Hand-played hi-hat, ride, crash and other ordinary timekeeper/accent roles do not continue by default; fills need the acoustic space and the drummer's hands are occupied.
musical_policy.timeline: Clave/bell timeline continues in timeline-based Latin/Afro-Cuban styles unless the fill itself contains timeline_primary and therefore temporarily owns/rephrases it.
musical_policy.independent_texture: Shaker/auxiliary-percussion texture continues in selected Latin/Caribbean ensemble styles, representing an independent percussion layer rather than the drummer's fill limbs.
musical_policy.all_other_roles: All normal backbeat, ghost, tom, hand-percussion, open-hat, ride/bell, crash/section-accent and electronic-detail roles are suppressed unless explicitly listed for that fill.
